item.title: The 2026 Honda CR-V VX e:HEV Is A Mature Choice
item.description: I’ve always maintained that Honda’s best model is the CR-V; while the Civic certainly put the brand on the map, the CR-V has kept it alive ever since. The importance of the CR-V is immeasurable and can be credited for starting the segment it now competes in, which is a top-selling segment globally.
